meta.title: Line-wise split: each line goes whole to its own best bidder, with exact amounts
gaps: Setup recipe closed_rfq_with_2_bids builds one line item instead of two, so line 2 split and exact per-vendor calculation cannot be fully expressed

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event where two QA vendors bid, and the bidding window is over.
steps: The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer awards the line to a vendor on the proposal for the invited QA vendor.
The buyer awards the line to a vendor on the proposal for a second QA vendor.
The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the event and check that “proposals” is not empty.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error. Read back afterwards: “proposals” is not empty.
